coverage.basis: Aries ingress exact boundary through the Daybreak frame containing the Cancer ingress

methodology.record_first: Official vault objects and audited Research Desk paths are captured before comparison. X-only notes are absent.
methodology.no_causality: A geometry/evidence rhyme is not a cause and receives no score.
methodology.calculate_once: Geometry is referenced only by IDs owned by the Daybreak engine packet; no degree, orb, house, aspect, or clock fact is recopied here.
methodology.clock_rule: instant_utc is populated only when an official or audited source establishes the real action instant. Bookmark timestamps and reconstructed 12:00 filenames are never event clocks.
methodology.boundary_rule: Date-only facts on split frames remain civil-date records with unresolved segment membership.
methodology.attention_policy: Attention/X records are absent from v1; they may never stand in for Official or Research evidence.

finding.rationale: Raw geometry density did not select event days: exact non-continuity parent-reference medians were equal, and trigger-eligible daily-delta medians were close. This season does not support a simple one-day event detector; sequence and delivery context remain testable.

provenance.record_counts: Authored from this payload's durable records after excluding Attention/X-only notes.
provenance.geometry_density: Audited against the canonical Daybreak engine geometry_index using the same evidence-date partition; persistent outer background, same-body continuity, and excluded America-derived contacts were not treated as selectors.
provenance.validator: validate_daybreak_retrospectives.py recomputes payload counts and verifies the engine hash before promotion.

season_summary.conclusion: No simple one-day event detector is supported. The strongest remaining use is testing sequence and delivery context without claiming causality.
